name: add-transaction
title: Add a transaction on the Transactions tab
body: Exercise the add-transaction flow on the Transactions (Ledger) tab end-to-end against the demo dataset. Find the control to add a transaction (e.g. an 'Add' / '+' button), open the form, fill plausible values (a small expense, a category, an account), and submit. Then confirm the new transaction appears in the list. This is a disposable demo instance — it is safe to create one transaction. Do NOT delete anything or reset data.

criteria.text: There is a discoverable control to add a transaction.
The add form opens and accepts amount / category / account input.
After submitting, the new transaction shows up in the transaction list.
